INFRARED SAUNA POWERBOARDS

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Some reasons to choose us!

  • You know you need quality and certified electrical appliances and parts for your infrared sauna, but you’re not sure which supplier to go to.
  • It’s important for you to ensure the safety of your sauna as well as your clients, so you want to make sure all your electrical needs are of the best quality.
  • Read more to learn which supplier can be the right one for you.

InfraredSaunaParts has been in business for more than 15 years and we know how frustrating it can be for you when you can’t find the right supplier to get you the things you need. It can be even more challenging when your current supplier told you that they don’t have the parts you use for your sauna anymore.

It’s not uncommon for infrared sauna parts suppliers to stop carrying certain parts after several years because they want to keep up with the modern demand. However, it can be difficult for sauna owners who prefer to have the same brand of item for their sauna. At InfraredSaunaParts, we’re able to get for your certain items that were manufactured even 5 – 10 years ago.

Important electrical components such as power boards, touchpad, and switches need to be of high quality to ensure the safety of your sauna and your clients. So when it comes to our electrical parts, we make sure they’re of the highest grade and passed through rigid safety inspection. You can rest assured that our items are certified and safe to be used in your sauna.

There various types of power boards offered at InfraredSaunaParts. All you have to do is browse through our extensive catalogue and find the right one that you need. If you feel that you can’t find what you’re looking for, let us know as soon as possible and we’re set out to find them for you. We’re constantly updating our catalogue so your input will be valuable to us.

Check the number below and call us today to learn how we can help you with your infrared sauna business!
